title: A recording with no words
note: The page shows the app's own small note instead of words, and no "From Mama" signature under it (the signature is only under words a person said); the recording is still there and can be kept, and "Write the words" opens the words sheet so the person can put the words with it. "Record again" is gone from this page: it started a separate letter.
text: Aa Wednesday, October 28, 2026 No words in this one. The recording is kept just as it is. Hear Mama 0:18 Write the words Add to book Delete
